metadata.title: Angle cocycles, Euler characteristic, and simplicial volume of smooth manifolds
metadata.abstract: A celebrated conjecture of Gromov states that for closed aspherical manifolds, the vanishing of simplicial volume implies the vanishing of the Euler characteristic. We prove Gromov's conjecture for closed convex projective manifolds and, more generally, for closed orientable smooth manifolds admitting an immersed straightening. Generalising the straightening of simplices in properly convex domains in real projective space, we introduce the notion of immersed straightening and prove that, for every integer $d\geq 1$, there exists a constant $C_d>0$ such that every closed orientable smooth $d$-manifold $M$ admitting an immersed straightening satisfies $|\chi(M)|\le C_d||M||$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Euler 特征与单纯体体积比较
analysis.workSummary: 对闭凸实射影流形及更一般有 immersed straightening 的闭定向光滑流形，建立 |χ(M)|≤C_d||M||，推出该类中单纯体体积为零时 Euler 特征也为零。
techniques: 有界上同调与基本类估计
analysis.breakthrough: 证明指定 d 维流形满足 |χ(M)|≤C_d||M||，从而在闭凸射影流形及更一般可直化类中得到 Gromov 的零体积蕴含零 Euler 特征结论。
analysis.limitations: 一般直化定理曾于 2011 年由第一作者报告，本文系统写出证明；不能将其说成所有闭非球面流形的完整猜想解答。比较依赖浸入直化，并不自动证明所有不可分解凸射影流形的单纯体体积为正；未逐步验证角余循环和直化构造。 已补读 Theorems 1.2、1.5 与 Euler 角余循环，不是对整篇证明的独立核验。
